newsitem.title: USA: Durakon reaches new pact with UAW.
newsitem.headline: Durakon reaches new pact with UAW.

text.p: Durakon Industries Inc said Wednesday members of United Auto Workers Local 540 have ratified a new three-year contract with the company.
No terms were disclosed for the pact, which covers 247 trimmers, machine operators, tooling and maintenance workers in Lapeer, Mich.

The previous contract expired February 28. The two sides reached a tentative agreement March 1 after mutually agreeing to extend the strike deadline without a work stoppage. UAW members ratified the contract March 4.

"The contract recognizes the achievements of our employees and allows us to continue providing our customers with the highest quality bedliners and accessories in a timely manner without any interruption," said David W. Wright, president and chief executive officer said in a statement.
Durakon sells pickup truck bedliners, light truck accessories and other products.
